verdict.rationale: Snyk CLI clearly supports headless/CI scanning (snyk test, snyk code test) and can run in pipelines, and Snyk Code/Jira integration lets teams track and export issues, plus an MCP server and agentic CLI hooks exist for AI-agent workflows. However, the evidence pack lacks explicit confirmation of structured/JSON machine-readable output flags and issue-filing beyond Jira export, and community feedback flags noisy/low-value findings that complicate 'real findings' filtering.
